build_web_document_filter_node_level: build a WebDocumentFilteringNodeLevel instance to filter web document nodes by image format, size, word count, and repetition ratios
build_web_document_filter_doc_level: build a WebDocumentFilteringDocLevel instance to filter entire web documents by image count, word count, and perplexity score
compute_perplexity_score: compute the perplexity score of a text using SentencePiece tokenization and a KenLM language model
compute_lang_id_pred_score: compute the predicted language ID and confidence score for a text using a fastText language identification model
compute_character_repetition_ratio: compute the character n-gram repetition ratio of a text to detect repetitive or low-quality content
